# Dolphoon

> Dolphoon is a multilingual learning platform offering practical online courses and structured skill paths for young people aged 13–18 in Arabic, English, and French.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Dolphoon's practical courses and skill paths for young people aged 13–18.
- [Courses](/courses): Educational courses on programming, AI, languages, and design for ages 13–18.
- [Skill Paths](/skill-paths): Structured learning journeys that combine multiple courses into progressive curricula.
- [Course Access](/subscription): Choose and purchase the right course for your learning goals.

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Sign in to your account.
- [Register](/register): Create a new account.
